title: Wadirih yuduure waklenta
intro: Atu nabiyyi silaalal mannoowak sugte roocih aydaadu qaddossam faxxam uxih finqa fan gexa gita doorte. Tama weelo Yalli doore farmoytit lih buxa luk suge takkay immay imaan aqayyaarel radeh. Tah bayte waklenta miyyaay?
clues: Anu nummah seeco cinna marih fanat mannoowak, ken masadiyyo.
Anu Yallih farmoytal digibeh suge, takkay immay Iimaanat maqambaala.
Farmoytit maabitina luk yi buxa temeete wak, anu ken maamina.
Yi barra mu'miniin lih magaala cabtuh amrisseh sugteeh, anu keenik fanat masugiyyo.
Digaala yi ummattal radeeh, anu ken luk finqiteh.
Anu Qur'aanak ceelalloh kufrih addat, Nuuh barra xaqut, Suurat At-Tahrim addal, edde yaabe.

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
